name: Coco
identity: Coco is a small adult Bichon Frisé mix with a fluffy, curly, bright white coat trimmed round on the head, a soft apricot patch on the left ear only, round dark brown eyes, a black nose, drop ears covered in curls, a long plumed tail, and a thin mint-green collar with a small silver heart tag.
drift: the apricot patch on the LEFT ear only, the mint-green collar with the silver heart tag, the round head trim
